titulo: A film that leaves no one indifferent
intro: Reading a cultural review and telling apart the summary, the evaluation and the recommendation.
p.reseña.consejo: The ñ sounds ny: rre-SE-nya. A review has facts, a summary and an opinion.
p.reparto.consejo: The «reparto» is the list of those who act. It also means handing out: «repartir».
p.ritmo.consejo: A film may have a slow or fast pace. The initial r is strong.
p.interpretación.consejo: It comes from «interpretar». It ends in -ción, so the stress is at the end.
p.fotografía.consejo: The accent on the i separates the vowels: fo-to-gra-FÍ-a. «Foto» is its short form.
p.previsible.consejo: It comes from «prever». A predictable story has no surprises.
p.conmovedor.consejo: It comes from «conmover». Feminine: «conmovedora». A moving scene can make you cry.
p.sobrio.consejo: The io forms a single syllable: SO-bryo. A restrained film does not exaggerate.
p.recomendar.consejo: The e becomes ie: «recomiendo», «recomiendas». You recommend a film to a friend.
p.vale la pena.consejo: You say «vale la pena verla» or «merece la pena». «Pena» here is effort, not sadness.
b1.titulo: A review says more than the plot
b1.texto:
A cultural review usually combines three things: the **facts** about the work (the **reparto**, the director), a short **summary** of its subject and the writer's **evaluation**.

Adjectives such as **sobrio**, **previsible** or **conmovedor** are not neutral facts: they show a point of view. To support an opinion, the critic talks about the **ritmo**, the **interpretación**, the **fotografía** or how the story is told.

The **recomendación** can be positive, negative or qualified: **vale la pena verla, aunque…** A review can praise one part and criticise another without contradicting itself.
b2.f0.texto: Have you read the review of Elena Ríos's new film?
b2.f1.texto: The critic talks about a very slow pace.
b2.f2.texto: I am more interested in the characters.
b2.f3.texto: The review praises the performance of the two sisters.
b2.f4.texto: It also says the cast works with great naturalness.
b2.f5.texto: The critic considers the ending predictable.
b2.f6.texto: I recommend that you see it anyway.
b2.f7.texto: It is worth it, although it is not a film for everyone.
b4.texto:
To evaluate without being blunt, praise and reservations are combined.

- **Aunque** + indicative: a fact that is acknowledged. **La fotografía es hermosa, aunque algunas escenas se repiten.**
- **Aunque** + subjunctive: something possible or irrelevant. **Vale la pena verla aunque no te guste el ritmo.**
- **Sin embargo** opens a sentence that contrasts with the previous one.
- **Vale la pena** + infinitive: **Vale la pena verla.**
b4.e0.texto: The cinematography is beautiful, although some scenes repeat.
b4.e1.texto: It is worth seeing even if you do not like the pace.
b4.e2.texto: However, the performance is very natural.
b5.titulo: The critic in the back row
b5.f0.texto: In the back row of the empty hall, the critic rests his notebook on his knees.
b5.f1.texto: The screen lights up and shows a white house at the edge of a dusty road.
b5.f2.texto: Two sisters unload boxes from a car and look in silence at the closed windows.
b5.f3.texto: No music is heard for several minutes.
b5.f4.texto: The critic writes the word slow in his notebook and underlines it twice.
b5.f5.texto: Little by little, the pace of the film stops being a flaw.
b5.f6.texto: The two actresses play their roles with an almost painful naturalness.
b5.f7.texto: The restrained cinematography turns the dry landscapes into a portrait of memory.
b5.f8.texto: Towards the end, the audience holds its breath before a door that does not open.
b5.f9.texto: When the lights come on, the critic crosses out the word slow and writes that it is worth it.
b6.o0: un texto que cuenta y valora una obra
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: a review summarises the work and gives an opinion.
b6.o1.refuerzo: A summary with no opinion is not a review.
b6.o2.refuerzo: An advert only wants to sell; a review evaluates.
b7.frase: Vale la pena verla, ____ algunas escenas se repiten.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «aunque» introduces a difficulty that does not stop the recommendation.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Por tanto» introduces a consequence, not a difficulty.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «A fin de que» introduces a purpose.
b8.frase: La fotografía es hermosa aunque algunas escenas se repiten
b8.traduccion: The cinematography is beautiful although some scenes repeat
b9.o0.refuerzo: That says what happens: it is a plot fact.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Yes: «muy natural» is the writer's judgement.
b9.o2.refuerzo: That is a fact of the story, not an opinion.
b9.pregunta: Which of these sentences is an evaluation?
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «conmovedora» is one that moves you deeply.
b11.o1.refuerzo: «Previsible» is one you can guess; it says nothing about emotion.
b11.pregunta: Which adjective describes a film that moves you?
b12.o0.refuerzo: A total criticism would not say it is worth it.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It does not tell the story: it gives an opinion.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Yes: it recommends the film but warns of a flaw.
b12.pregunta: What does «vale la pena verla, aunque…» indicate?
p.leído.consejo: With «haber», the i takes an accent: «has leído».
p.crítico.consejo: «El crítico» or «la crítica» for a woman. Stress on KRI.
p.interesan.consejo: Works like «gustar»: «me interesan» means they interest me.
p.personajes.consejo: Masculine plural: «el personaje». The j sounds like «h».
p.elogia.consejo: From «elogio», praise. The g before i sounds like «h».
p.hermanas.consejo: The h is silent. Feminine plural: «la hermana».
p.naturalidad.consejo: From «natural». The -dad ending is always feminine.
p.considera.consejo: «Considerar» means to think or judge. Stress on DE.
p.verla.consejo: The pronoun «la» attaches to the infinitive: «ver» + «la».
p.modos.consejo: Used in «de todos modos», anyway. Masculine plural.
p.escenas.consejo: Feminine plural: «la escena». The c before e sounds like «th».
p.guste.consejo: After «aunque», use the subjunctive: «aunque no te guste».
p.descargan.consejo: «Descargar» is to unload. The g before a sounds hard.
p.subraya.consejo: «Subrayar» comes from «raya», line. The y sounds like «y».
p.defecto.consejo: Masculine: «el defecto». The c before t sounds like «k».
p.actrices.consejo: Feminine plural of «actriz». The c before i sounds like «th».
p.sobria.consejo: Feminine of «sobrio». The b sounds soft, like «v».
p.paisajes.consejo: Masculine plural: «el paisaje». The j sounds like «h».
p.encenderse.glosa: to light up, to switch on
p.encenderse.consejo: The «se» attaches to the infinitive. The c before e sounds like «th».
p.tacha.consejo: «Tachar» means to cross out. The ch sounds like «ch» in «chair».
p.texto.consejo: Masculine: «el texto». The x sounds like «ks».
p.valora.consejo: Related to «valor», value. The v sounds like «b».
p.recomendación.consejo: From «recomendar». Words ending in -ción are feminine.
p.reservas.consejo: Feminine plural: «la reserva». Stress on SER.
